description: This file contains utility functions for Kubernetes kubelet, including cache modification, hostname resolution, container validation, and resource limit calculations.

methods.name: FromApiserverCache
methods.description: Modifies GetOptions to serve requests from the apiserver cache by setting ResourceVersion to '0'.

methods.name: GetNodenameForKernel
methods.description: Constructs the hostname or FQDN for the kernel, ensuring it fits within Linux kernel limits.

methods.name: GetContainerByIndex
methods.description: Validates and retrieves a container at a specified index, ensuring name consistency between container and status.

methods.name: GetLimits
methods.description: Calculates resource limits for a container, applying pod-level defaults if container limits are not explicitly set.
